title: JoshiiBoi's OP Tools
description: This mod adds overpowered tools and weapons to minecraft with the new Chungus Ore.
body:
Are you looking for a mod with excessively overpowered tools?


Well this is the right one for you!
Below is a list of the items you will find in this mods


Chungus Pickaxe:
- Instamines most ores
- Instantly breaks stone
- Easy to craft using Chungus Ingot
- Has over 10k durability

Chungus Axe:
- Instantly chop down any tree when using the Chungus Axe and Tree Harvester mod.
- Easily Crafted with Chungus Ingot
- also has over 10k durability
- Does 19 hit points


Chungus Sword:
- One shots most players
- Has an excessive ammount of durability
- Easy to craft with Chungus Ingot

Chungus Ingots:
- Easily obtainable, not requiring smelting

Chungus Ore:
- A lot in your world
- Only need to break between 1 and 5 blocks to get every tool
- can be mined with a stone pickaxe
